A successful stellar merger ..
Scientists recently spotted a star slightly less massive than the Sun merging into a puffy supergiant star in the outskirts of the Andromeda galaxy. This hard-to-observe event resulted in a new star nicknamed "Bao." go.nasa.gov/492jZad

node.content-desc: Image: On the left, a view of about half of the Andromeda Galaxy. It is annotated with a small white square to show the location of the merging stars. On the right, a series of four images from NEOWISE, SphereX, and Webb telescopes shows before, during, and after the merger.
